If the loop is enabled and the ramping function is enabled and the loop is in auto mode, compare the auto control set point with the saved value and if NEQ, set the auto one-shot and save the new set point for subsequent comparisons.

If the loop is enabled and the ramping function is enabled and the loop is in manual mode, compare the manual control set point with the saved value and if NEQ, set the manual one-shot and save the new set point for subsequent comparisons.
Save the current loop CV as the ramp starting point when the ramp function is initialized.

At the start of an auto mode ramp, if the new set point is greater than the current PV, set the ramp up flag and clear the ramp down flag if control is SP-PV or set the ramp down flag and clear the ramp up flag if control is PV-SP.

At the start of an auto mode ramp, if the new set point is less than the current PV, clear the ramp up flag and set the ramp down flag if control is SP-PV or clear the ramp down flag and set the ramp up flag if control is PV-SP.

At the start of a manual mode ramp, if the new set point is greater than the current CV, set the ramp up flag and clear the ramp down flag. If the new set point is less than the current CV, set the ramp down flag and clear the ramp up flag.
Clamp the ramp slope from 0.5 pct/sec to 100.0 pct/sec.
Enable the ramp timer if ramping up or down.  The timer is reset when not ramping and when a new ramp is started during a ramp.

When ramping up, calculate the loop CV from y=mx+b where m is the configured ramp slope, x is the current timer value and b is the ramp starting point.  The timer value is divided by 1000 to convert the sub-second timer to seconds.
When ramping up in manual mode and the CV is GEQ the manual set point, clear the ramp up flag and set the CV equal to the manual set point.

When ramping up in auto mode, if the PV is GEQ the auto set point and control is SP-PV or if the PV is LEQ the auto set point and control is PV-SP or if the loop is within deadband or if the CV the max value, clear the ramp up flag.

When ramping down, calculate the loop CV from y=-mx+b where m is the configured ramp slope, x is the current timer value and b is the ramp starting point.  The timer value is divided by 1000 to convert the sub-second timer to seconds.
When ramping down in manual mode and the CV is LEQ the manual set point, clear the ramp down flag and set the CV equal to the manual set point.

When ramping down in auto mode, if the PV is LEQ the auto set point and control is SP-PV or if the PV is GEQ the auto set point and control is PV-SP or if the loop is within deadband or if the CV is LEQ the min value, clear the ramp down flag.
